absent: Page descriptor bit layouts and permission encodings beyond the swap field widths shown
Locking and allocation discipline for page table pages beyond atomic entry updates and tag range locking
Address space split and table base selection for user versus kernel walks
TLB broadcast scope and barrier rules beyond the local only and no sync behaviors shown
Memory tag storage format and retrieval path; only invalidation and release are shown
Enablement timing and phase interactions for runtime level folding
Full fault handling flow around access flag updates including spurious fault repair
Modify protection transaction start and commit semantics beyond presence markers

findings.text: Middle and upper table levels provide clearing and address translation services. Clearing installs a zero descriptor through the level setter. Translation derives a physical page base from a descriptor and optionally a kernel virtual view or table pointer. Upper level clears act only when that level is enabled at runtime, while middle level clears are unconditional.

Child entry location is derived from a singly read parent entry by combining the parent page base with an address index scaled by descriptor size. Kernel image variants translate that physical location into the kernel image address space. Upper level walkers assert enablement of their level.

Each level offers a fixed slot mapping service with setup and release operations. Plain setup maps a given address through the level slot. Offset setup first derives the child physical location and then maps it. Release vacates the slot. Upper level setup checks runtime enablement before mapping.

Runtime disablement folds an upper layer away. Fold queries report folding directly from the enable flag. When folded, offset helpers return the incoming pointer unchanged, mapping helpers return an empty result or a folded pointer, clears become silent no operations, and physical extraction is unavailable. User execute evaluation collapses to plain user evaluation.

Empty means a zero descriptor value, with upper levels also requiring runtime enablement. Malformed means the descriptor type field differs from the table encoding, again gated by enablement at upper levels. Leaf marker is defined as present for this configuration.
Each table level provides a malformed entry diagnostic that reports source file plus line together with the offending descriptor value.

User permission at upper levels is evaluated by viewing the descriptor through a leaf interpretation. Page accessibility additionally requires validity, with block levels requiring a non table leaf descriptor and either user or user execute permission.

Access flag installation funnels leaf and block callers into a common sized worker. It succeeds immediately when current and proposed entries already match. Otherwise it narrows the proposal to access related permissions, merges them atomically with inverted read control handling that stays safe against concurrent hardware updates, and on dirty requests invalidates the local range without walk cache or broadcast using a level selected from the size.

Direct clear writes zero without translation maintenance. Test and clear of youth loops atomically until stable and reports prior youth. Flush variant additionally invalidates one page without synchronization when youth was present, relying on a later context switch barrier to bound staleness. Block youth test warns on table entries lacking hardware support and reuses the leaf worker.

Write protection and selective clearing of youth and dirtiness use atomic compare loops over the entry value. Clearing both youth and dirtiness together uses a direct store, while partial requests loop per selected flag. Batch helpers walk consecutive slots advancing the address by one page per entry.

Fetch with clear atomically exchanges the entry with zero and runs size specific accounting, warning on unknown sizes. Batch clear walks an array discarding each result. Collecting batch clear folds dirtiness and youth from later slots into the first result. Block establish exchanges the new descriptor while accounting the installation.

Protection replacement preserves hardware dirtiness across the merge, combines only the permission and attribute subset from the new protection with the old value, and reasserts hardware dirtiness when software dirtiness survives. Block replacement reuses the leaf merge by converting forth and back.

Swap encoding places a 5 bit type at bit 6 and a 50 bit offset at bit 12. Extraction helpers isolate each field and construction combines a type offset pair into one value. Conversions between leaf descriptors or block descriptors and swap entries preserve the raw value unchanged. A build assertion limits the configured swap file count to the type width.

Swap tag maintenance runs only when memory tagging is supported. Single page invalidation erases one stored tag object and releases its storage. Whole area invalidation erases a contiguous type range while holding the store lock, releasing each object. Storage release frees the allocation. Separate markers advertise prepare plus invalidate plus restore support.
Single page maintenance aligns the address down to its page base and flushes exactly one page at leaf level without walk cache while forwarding caller supplied flags.

Folded lockless descent reuses the original top table pointer instead of a possibly stack resident copy when building the next level pointer, because the fast path can pass a stack entry that generic offset logic would misinterpret as table memory. Repeated loads of the same live entry stay safe through same address read ordering.

Post mapping cache maintenance is intentionally empty, accepting a small chance of an immediate repeat fault to keep the fast path free of a barrier. Single entry and block helpers reduce to the range form or to nothing.

Leaf youth and aged prefault behavior track access flag hardware support, while non leaf block youth tracks Haft support. Executable folio order is the base two logarithm of 64K divided by page size. Block section support exists only with 4K pages. Markers advertise modify protection transaction start and commit.

Range tag erasure acquires the tag store lock, iterates the type interval erasing each index and freeing its storage, then releases the lock. Single entry erasure and storage release show no explicit locking in these fragments.

Page descriptors and swap entries share a single integer value representation with lossless reinterpret conversions between them. Translation helpers expose physical bases plus kernel virtual addresses plus page structures as alternate views of the same table page.

Each upper level enable flag selects between full and folded behavior. Enabled state performs real walks plus fixed slot mappings plus clears. Disabled state passes the incoming pointer through, suppresses mappings and clears, and reports the layer as folded.
Access flag update invalidates only the local stale read only entry. Remote stale entries can still trigger faults and are repaired through the spurious fault flush path.
